raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 13 (ingested 2026-01-18) delivered merchant_id as 'M-0NNN' strings instead of plain integers, so CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) fails. The prefixed IDs look like the same merchant keys: 80 distinct values would be 40 numeric plus 40 prefixed, and the max 'M-0139' lines up with raw_merchants IDs 100-139. Stripping the 'M-' prefix and casting recovers the correct integer ID.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CASE WHEN regexp_full_match(trim(merchant_id), 'M-[0-9]+') THEN CAST(substr(trim(merchant_id), 3) AS INTEGER) ELSE CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) END AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
